summary: New box Infectum: example for sense 1 in Infectum (Jan 2.23/4056)

data.turoyo: D fəyašliyo əšmo, aṯar. Mərle: "Ṭaw məd manṭeno malfono, d maqreno an naʕime di qriṯo d minawri w haṯe gədfašliyo ləno. Ham kayəsto yo li qriṯayḏi ste gədminawro w gədfašliyo aṯar ste kayiso.
data.translation: So that a name, a trace, may remain for me.” He said, “It is good if I bring a teacher to teach the village children, so they become enlightened, and this will remain for me. It is good for my village too; it will be enlightened, and a good trace will remain for me.

summary: New box Infectum: example for sense 1 in Infectum (Jan 3.56/1683)

data.turoyo: Mawfaqxu faṣəl mu Mgalyən d qoralxu. Ham gədminawrutu w ham gədmṣalutu. I naqqa dowe qašo, ṭabiʕi gtowe qerowo. Lawi qašo, šamošo ewangeloyo, kibe mṣale b qamuṯe d kulxu.
data.translation: Take out a passage from the Gospel for yourselves, so that he reads it to you. You will both be enlightened and pray. When there is a priest, naturally there will be a Eucharist. If there is no priest, an evangelical deacon can pray at the head of all of you.

rationale: New D1 Infectum box, second-person plural and Gospel-reading context, with an overt mi- form. English is the supplied project machine translation, not an edition translation.
